name: TAGX3 Commercial Validation Protocol v1
purpose: Measure detection quality and timing without changing production model thresholds from isolated cases.
rules: No production score/weight/threshold changes are authorized by this protocol.
Every outcome must use a snapshot captured after the signal observation; future evidence may not be injected into the historical signal.
If the requested horizon has no captured observation within tolerance, the outcome is MISSING rather than interpolated or fabricated.
Sharia eligibility is reported separately from raw model detection quality; NON_COMPLIANT/UNVERIFIED cases are not promoted to evidence-complete opportunities.
Commercial edge may not be claimed until multiple sessions and an out-of-sample holdout have been evaluated.
